# Task
Customer lookups should also return each customer's phone number.

Capability: customers.lookup@1

raw.text:

report.reason: This needs a contract change; changing the implementation alone can't do it. The contract for customers.lookup@1 allows only these outputs: /customerId, /name, /email, /tier and /since. It has no phone field. Its mustPreserve rule 'output.return-no-more' says the capability may 'return only what the current output schema allows', so adding a phone number to the response would break the contract. Contracts can't be changed here, so I made no proposal. Two further issues: the contract has no verification methods (evidence.establishable is false), and billing.contact@1 depends on this capability's output, so any change would also need to be checked against it. To add phone numbers, the contract owner would need to add an optional /phone output (ideally with a phone concept annotation), probably as a new version such as customers.lookup@2 or a deliberate revision of @1. After that, the handler in src/handlers/customers.lookup.mjs could be updated to fill it in from src/legacy/crm.mjs.
